name: 王宫的通告
rarity: 面闪SR，银字R，黄金GR，平卡N，平爆NPR
desc: ①：只要这张卡在魔法与陷阱区域存在，这张卡以外的场上的全部陷阱卡的效果无效化。
ruling: If “Skill Drain” is active on the field when “Jinzo” is summoned, and “Royal Decree” is later activated, “Royal Decree” will negate “Skill Drain”. Since “Skill Drain” is no longer negating “Jinzo’s” effect, “Jinzo” will negate both “Royal Decree” and “Skill Drain.”
